subject: DI04005011

body.en:
Definition and classification

A fuel releases useful energy through controlled reaction,usually combustion.Classify by physical state:solid(coal,coke,biomass),liquid(petroleum fuels,biofuels) and gas(natural gas,producer/water/coke-oven gas).Classify by origin as primary/natural and secondary/manufactured;renewable/non-renewable is another independent basis.

Selection and applications

Consider calorific value,moisture/ash,sulfur,ignition,storage,flame control,availability and emissions.Gases give controllable mixing butneed leak prevention/appropriate burners.Solid fuels need ash handling;liquid fuels need suitable atomisation.Heating,power generation,metallurgy and chemical synthesis use different purity and combustion requirements.GCV includes recovered combustion-water condensation heat;NCV excludes that latent heat.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા વર્ગીકરણ

Controlled reaction,સામાન્ય રીતે combustionથી useful energy આપતો પદાર્થ fuel છે. State મુજબ solid(coal,coke,biomass),liquid(petroleum fuels,biofuels) તથા gas(natural,producer/water/coke-oven gas). Origin મુજબ primary/natural તથા secondary/manufactured;renewable/non-renewable અલગ basis છે.

પસંદગી તથા ઉપયોગો

Calorific value,moisture/ash,sulfur,ignition,storage,flame control,availability તથા emissions જુઓ. Gasમાં mixing control સારું,પણ leak prevention/યોગ્ય burners જોઈએ. Solid fuelsમાં ash handling તથા liquid fuelsમાં atomisation જોઈએ. Heating,power,metallurgy/synthesisની purity/combustion requirements જુદી છે. GCVમાં combustion-water condensation heat આવે છે;NCVમાં તે latent heat નથી.

body.en:
Classification

Industrial gases include oxygen,nitrogen,hydrogen,carbon dioxide,argon,acetylene and synthesis/fuel gases.Classify by function:oxidising,inert/shielding,combustible,reducing or process feed.A gas can fit more than one function;nitrogen is not chemically inert in every reaction.

Sources and uses

O2/N2/argon:air separation or suitable adsorption/membrane routes;steel/medical oxygen,inerting and welding shielding according to purity.H2:reforming,electrolysis or by-product recovery;ammonia,hydrogenation/refining.CO2:fermentation/process streams or geological sources with purification;carbonation,refrigeration and process uses.Acetylene:approved carbide or hydrocarbon routes;welding/chemical feed.CO/H2syngas:gasification/reforming,followed by conditioning for synthesis.

Hazards and specifications

Oxygen enriches fire risk,hydrogen ignites readily,CO is highly toxic,and even nitrogen/CO2 can displace breathable oxygen.Cylinder pressure,purity,moisture and compatibility must match service.Industrial purity does not automatically qualify a gas for medical/food use.
body.gu:
વર્ગીકરણ

Oxygen,nitrogen,hydrogen,CO2,argon,acetylene તથા synthesis/fuel gases industrial gases છે. Function મુજબ oxidising,inert/shielding,combustible,reducing અથવા process feed. એક gas એકથી વધુ functionsમાં આવી શકે;nitrogen દરેક reactionમાં inert નથી.

Sources તથા Uses

O2/N2/argon air separation અથવા suitable adsorption/membrane routesથી;purity મુજબ steel/medical oxygen,inerting તથા welding shieldingમાં. H2 reforming,electrolysis/by-product recoveryથી;ammonia,hydrogenation/refiningમાં. CO2 fermentation/process/geological sourcesમાંથી purification પછી;carbonation,refrigeration/process usesમાં. Acetylene approved carbide/hydrocarbon routesથી;welding/chemical feedમાં. CO/H2syngas gasification/reformingથી તથા conditioning પછી synthesisમાં.

Hazards તથા Specifications

Oxygen fire risk વધારે છે,hydrogen સરળતાથી ignite થાય છે,CO highly toxic છે અને nitrogen/CO2 પણ oxygen displace કરે છે. Cylinder pressure,purity,moisture/compatibility service મુજબ જોઈએ. Industrial grade આપમેળે medical/food grade નથી.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Producer gas is a relatively low-calorific fuel gas made by partial oxidation of coal/coke with air,commonly with steam moderation;nitrogen strongly dilutes it.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Coal/coke,air and controlled steam;feed and ash behaviour govern the generator arrangement.

C + O2 → CO2;CO2 + C ⇌ 2CO;C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2.

Your supplied drawing—page 15

Air-blown gas is nitrogen-rich;do not copy water-gas composition.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Generator construction and heating zones

The supplied vertical producer contains a descending solid bed and a lower air/steam entry.Fuel burns partially near the oxidant zone and supplies heat;hot CO2/steam react further with carbon above it to produce CO/H2.Rising gas also dries/devolatilises upper feed.The water/steam moderation and hot-water service shown are not a claim that air contains no nitrogen.

2. Ash,heat exchange and gas use

Mineral residue is removed by the designed ash system;the source notes that ash condition and furnace arrangement affect removal.Raw gas passes through heat exchange and appropriate dust/tar cleanup before distribution.Producer gas contains substantial N2and therefore has lower heating value per volume than many richer fuel gases;the exact composition is feed/design-dependent.

3. Heat and reaction balance

Partial combustion supplies exothermic heat for endothermic reduction/steam reactions.Too little heat lowers useful gas generation;poor oxidant distribution causes channels and unconverted carbon.Gas leakage is dangerous even when its calorific value is low because of CO toxicity.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control air/steam distribution,bed pressure drop,ash removal,dust and CO containment;do not equate its composition with water gas.

Properties / applications

Approved industrial furnace/heating fuel,subject to burner and gas-cleaning requirements.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Airથી coal/cokeનું partial oxidation,ઘણી વાર steam moderation સાથે,કરી મળતું relatively low-calorific,N2-diluted fuel producer gas છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Coal/coke,air તથા controlled steam;feed/ash behaviour મુજબ generator arrangement હોય છે.

C + O2 → CO2;CO2 + C ⇌ 2CO;C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 15

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Generator Construction તથા Heating Zones

મૂળ vertical producerમાં descending solid bed તથા lower air/steam entry છે. Oxidant zone પાસે partial burningથી heat મળે છે;ઉપર hot CO2/steam carbon સાથે વધુ react થઈ CO/H2 આપે છે. Rising gas upper feed dry/devolatilise કરે છે. Water/steam moderation તથા hot-water serviceથી airનું nitrogen દૂર થતું નથી.

2. Ash,Heat Exchange તથા Gas Use

Mineral residue designed ash systemથી બહાર જાય છે;source મુજબ ash condition/furnace arrangement removalને અસર કરે છે. Raw gas heat exchange તથા યોગ્ય dust/tar cleanup પછી distribute થાય છે. Producer gasમાં N2ઘણું હોવાથી અનેક richer gases કરતાં પ્રતિvolume heating value ઓછી છે;exact composition feed/design પર આધારિત છે.

3. Heat તથા Reaction Balance

Partial combustion endothermic reduction/steam reactions માટે heat આપે છે. Heat ઓછી હોય તો useful gas generation ઘટે છે;poor oxidant distributionથી channels/unconverted carbon રહે છે. Low-calorific હોવા છતાં COને કારણે gas leakage જોખમી છે.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Air/steam distribution,bed pressure drop,ash,dust તથા CO containment નિયંત્રિત કરવા;water gasની composition સાથે સમાન ન માનવું.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Burner/gas-cleaning requirements મુજબ approved industrial furnace/heating fuel.

notes.reaction: C + O2 → CO2;CO2 + C ⇌ 2CO;C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Water gas is CO/H2-rich gas formed mainly by passing steam over hot carbon;the supplied regenerative process alternates air-blow heating and steam-run production.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Coke/hot carbon,air for the blow period and steam for the product-generating run.

C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2(endothermic);C + O2 → CO2 during separate heating phase.

Your supplied drawing—page 14

Regenerative blow and run phases are separate in time;blow gas is not mixed with the selected water-gas product.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Blow phase

Air is admitted to heat the carbon bed by combustion.The resulting nitrogen-containing blow gas is routed to the appropriate heat-recovery/combustion outlet,not mixed indiscriminately with product water gas.The reference shows paired generators that can be on different phases.

2. Steam run and cycle switching

Air is isolated under the engineered switching arrangement and steam passes over hot carbon.The endothermic carbon–steam reaction makes CO/H2and cools the bed.Eventually a new heating period is required.Cycle valves and gas segregation distinguish this operation from simultaneous air-blown producer-gas generation.

3. Cleanup and alternate continuous route

Run gas is cooled/cleaned and collected.The lower reference drawing instead shows continuous operation with a separate combustion/oxygen-containing supply and pulverised-coal reactor;it is an alternative,not an additional vessel required after every regenerative generator.Both need a reliable heat source and ash/gas management.

Engineering and quality considerations

Prevent air/product cross-contamination,flashback and CO exposure.Control cycle state,temperature and pressure;no manual switching recipe is given.

Properties / applications

Historical fuel gas and synthesis feed after appropriate ratio adjustment/purification.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Hot carbon પર steamથી મુખ્યત્વે CO/H2-rich water gas બને છે;મૂળ regenerative processમાં air-blow heating તથા steam-run production alternate થાય છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Coke/hot carbon,blow period માટે air તથા product run માટે steam લેવાય છે.

C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2(endothermic);C + O2 → CO2 during separate heating phase.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 14

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Blow Phase

Airથી carbon bed combustion દ્વારા ગરમ થાય છે. Nitrogenવાળું blow gas યોગ્ય heat-recovery/combustion outletમાં જાય છે,product water gas સાથે મનસ્વી રીતે ભળતું નથી. Referenceમાં paired generators જુદા phases પર હોઈ શકે છે.

2. Steam Run તથા Cycle Switching

Engineered switchingથી air isolate થયા પછી steam hot carbon પરથી જાય છે. Endothermic reaction CO/H2બનાવે છે અને bed ઠંડો પડે છે;પછી ફરી heating period જોઈએ. Cycle valves/gas segregation આ operationને simultaneous air-blown producer gasથી જુદું કરે છે.

3. Cleanup તથા Alternate Continuous Route

Run gas cool/clean થઈ collect થાય છે. Referenceનું lower drawing separate combustion/oxygen-containing supply તથા pulverised-coal reactorવાળી continuous alternative છે;દરેક regenerative generator પછી ફરજિયાત વધારાનું vessel નથી. બંનેમાં reliable heat source તથા ash/gas management જોઈએ.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Air/product cross-contamination,flashback તથા CO exposure રોકવાં. Cycle state,temperature/pressure નિયંત્રિત કરવા;manual switching recipe આપેલ નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

યોગ્ય ratio adjustment/purification પછી historical fuel gas તથા synthesis feedમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Coke-oven gas is the combustible volatile-gas fraction recovered during oxygen-excluded carbonisation of coking coal.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Coking coal,external heating and grade-specific gas-recovery reagents/scrubbing oil.

Complex coal carbonisation → coke + raw gas + tar/liquor;not one balanced molecular reaction.

Your supplied drawing—page 13

PDF includes an optional deep-cleanup/ammonia-synthesis branch;not part of every fuel-gas plant.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Oven and primary recovery

The by-product oven heats coal indirectly;combustion air is kept out of the coal charge.The solid coke outlet serves metallurgy while raw volatile gas passes through the cooler and electrostatic tar/dust recovery shown in the PDF.This gas is not simply pure hydrogen despite its useful hydrogen content.

2. Ammonia and light-oil recovery

The selected acid-contact stage recovers ammonia as an ammonium salt;the source labels ammonium sulphate.Light-oil scrubbing recovers benzene-range aromatics from gas.The cleaned fuel-gas stream requires its own contaminant specification;recovered tar and aromatic oils are separate co-products.

3. Fuel route versus deep cleanup

The reference lower branch shows additional scrubbing/liquefaction-type purification toward synthesis gas.This is optional deep processing for a different downstream duty,not proof that all fuel coke-oven gas passes through an ammonia-synthesis feed train.The study drawing stops at the cleaned fuel-gas boundary.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control tar aerosols,ammonia,benzene/PAH exposure,H2S/CO and flammable-gas leakage;do not rely on printed historical gas percentages as a universal analysis.

Properties / applications

Oven/heating fuel and,after much deeper conditioning,chemical/hydrogen feed.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Coking coalના oxygen-excluded carbonisationમાં મળતો combustible volatile-gas fraction coke-oven gas છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Coking coal,external heating તથા grade-specific recovery reagents/scrubbing oil લેવાય છે.

Complex coal carbonisation → coke + raw gas + tar/liquor;not one balanced molecular reaction.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 13

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Oven તથા Primary Recovery

By-product oven coalને indirectly ગરમ કરે છે;combustion air chargeની બહાર રહે છે. Solid coke metallurgyમાં જાય છે;raw gas PDFના cooler તથા electrostatic tar/dust recoveryમાં જાય છે. Useful hydrogen content હોવા છતાં gas pure hydrogen નથી.

2. Ammonia તથા Light-oil Recovery

Selected acid-contact stage ammoniaને ammonium salt તરીકે recover કરે છે;sourceમાં ammonium sulphate છે. Light-oil scrubbing gasમાંથી benzene-range aromatics કાઢે છે. Cleaned fuel gas માટે contaminant specification જોઈએ;tar તથા aromatic oils અલગ co-products છે.

3. Fuel Route તથા Deep Cleanupનો ભેદ

Referenceની lower branch synthesis gas માટે additional scrubbing/liquefaction-type purification બતાવે છે. આ જુદા downstream dutyનું optional deep processing છે;દરેક fuel gas ammonia-synthesis feed trainમાં જાય એવું નથી. Study drawing cleaned fuel-gas boundary પર પૂરી થાય છે.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Tar aerosols,ammonia,benzene/PAH,H2S/CO તથા flammable-gas leaks નિયંત્રિત કરવા;historical percentages universal analysis નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Oven/heating fuel તથા વધુ deep conditioning પછી chemical/hydrogen feed.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

Natural gas is a naturally occurring methane-rich mixture produced from reservoirs and processed to meet sales-gas specifications.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Raw reservoir gas containing variable water,condensate,CO2,H2S and heavier hydrocarbons.

Mainly extraction and separation,not coal gasification or a single gas-synthesis reaction.

Your supplied drawing—page 12

PDF groups drying/heavy-end/acid-gas services in another order and shows alternatives;actual order depends on feed/design.Natural gas is extracted,not manufactured from coal.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Production and inlet separation

Well collection brings reservoir fluid to surface separators,where free water and condensate are removed.Corrosive/acid gases and entrained liquids determine material and safety needs.Associated gas comes with oil production;non-associated gas comes from gas reservoirs.Natural origin does not make raw gas immediately suitable for a pipeline.

2. Dehydration and heavy-end removal

The reference shows drying by solid adsorbent alternatives or refrigeration,and heavy-end removal by absorption or liquefaction/fractionation with lean-oil recycle.Water removal prevents hydrate/corrosion problems;heavy-hydrocarbon recovery controls dew point and yields NGL.These options are not all mandatory vessels connected in one series.

3. Acid-gas absorption/regeneration and delivery

The amine-type absorber removes acid gases and the stripper regenerates solvent,with H2S-rich streams sent to approved treatment.Sales gas is conditioned,compressed and metered for transmission.The new drawing places sweetening before dehydration for a representative train;the source groups services differently.Actual ordering follows feed/process design,so its alternatives are explained rather than falsely copied as a universal sequence.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control H2S,toxic/flammable leaks,water/hydrocarbon dew points,methane emissions and compressor pressure;LNG is liquefied gas,not chemically LPG.

Properties / applications

Fuel for power,heat and transport as specified;feed for hydrogen/ammonia,methanol and petrochemicals after appropriate conversion.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Reservoirમાંથી મળતું methane-rich mixture natural gas છે;processingથી sales-gas specification મળે છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Raw reservoir gasમાં variable water,condensate,CO2,H2S તથા heavier hydrocarbons હોય છે.

Mainly extraction and separation,not coal gasification or a single gas-synthesis reaction.

તમે મોકલેલું Drawing—પાનું 12

મૂળ drawingના equipment names અને દેખાતા connections પ્રમાણે નીચે working સમજાવ્યું છે. Faint/clipped ભાગ માટે complete study redraw પણ આપ્યો છે;અસ્પષ્ટ labelsને અંદાજથી exact design માન્યાં નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Production તથા Inlet Separation

Well collectionથી fluid surface separatorsમાં આવે છે અને free water/condensate જુદાં થાય છે. Corrosive/acid gases તથા liquidsથી material/safety needs નક્કી થાય છે. Associated gas oil સાથે અને non-associated gas gas reservoirsમાંથી મળે છે. Natural હોવા છતાં raw gas સીધું pipeline-grade નથી.

2. Dehydration તથા Heavy-end Removal

Referenceમાં solid adsorbent alternatives અથવા refrigerationથી drying તથા absorption/ liquefaction-fractionationથી heavy-end removal અને lean-oil recycle છે. Water removal hydrate/corrosion રોકે છે;heavy-hydrocarbon recovery dew point નિયંત્રિત કરીને NGL આપે છે. બધા options એક seriesમાં ફરજિયાત vessels નથી.

3. Acid-gas Absorption/Regeneration તથા Delivery

Amine-type absorber acid gases દૂર કરે છે અને stripper solvent regenerate કરે છે;H2S-rich streams approved treatmentમાં જાય છે. Sales gas condition/compress/meter થઈ transmissionમાં જાય છે. New representative trainમાં sweetening dehydration પહેલાં છે;source services જુદા ક્રમમાં group કરે છે. Actual order feed/design પ્રમાણે છે,એટલે universal sequence તરીકે ખોટું copy નથી કર્યું.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

H2S,toxic/flammable leaks,water/hydrocarbon dew points,methane emissions તથા compressor pressure નિયંત્રિત કરવા;LNG અને LPG chemically સમાન નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Specification મુજબ power,heat/transport fuel તથા યોગ્ય conversion પછી hydrogen/ammonia,methanol/petrochemicalsના feedમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Aim

Determine volatile matter of fuel

Principle

A specified proximate-analysis heating method measures mass driven off excluding the defined moisture correction;method/atmosphere determine the result.

Apparatus/materials

Specified covered crucible,balance,desiccator,qualified furnace,tongs and assigned prepared fuel.

Supervised procedure / record

Record the applicable standard and sample basis.Preweigh the covered crucible/add sample;the instructor carries out the specified furnace exposure.Cool as required in a desiccator and reweigh.Apply the moisture correction for that method,not an invented universal temperature/time.

Blank observations—actual experiment required

Tare(g):____;sample(g):____;loss(g):____;moisture(%same basis):____;standard:____

Calculations and result

VM(%)=100×heating loss/sample mass−moisture(%) where the selected method uses this as-received correction.Dry-basis reporting must use the appropriate denominator.

Result:____;units:____;SOP/reference:____.No experiment/readings/results have been fabricated.

Precautions and waste

No opening hot furnace without authorisation;avoid CO/hot crucible exposure.

Aim

Determine ash content of fuel

Principle

Ash is inorganic residue after prescribed controlled oxidation;it is not the volatile-matter residue.

Apparatus/materials

Approved crucible,balance,desiccator,muffle furnace and assigned fuel.

Supervised procedure / record

Record tare/sample mass and method.The instructor performs the prescribed controlled ashing,including repeat heating/cooling to the defined constant-mass criterion.Cool in a desiccator,reweigh and state moisture basis.

Crucible tare(g):____;sample(g):____;crucible+ash(g):____;constant-mass checks:____

Calculations and result

Ash(%)=(crucible+ash−tare)/sample mass×100 on the stated basis.

Result:____;units:____;SOP/reference:____.No experiment/readings/results have been fabricated.

Precautions and waste

Use rated tongs/PPE and avoid dust inhalation;hot crucibles look cold.

body.gu: C + O2 → CO2;CO2 + C ⇌ 2CO;C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2.

body.gu: C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2(endothermic);C + O2 → CO2 during separate heating phase.

body.en: Complex coal carbonisation → coke + raw gas + tar/liquor;not one balanced molecular reaction.
body.gu: Complex coal carbonisation → coke + raw gas + tar/liquor;not one balanced molecular reaction.

body.en: Mainly extraction and separation,not coal gasification or a single gas-synthesis reaction.
body.gu: Mainly extraction and separation,not coal gasification or a single gas-synthesis reaction.

q.en: Explain the principle of Fuels—types,sources and uses.

a.en: A fuel releases useful energy through controlled reaction,usually combustion.Classify by physical state:solid(coal,coke,biomass),liquid(petroleum fuels,biofuels) and gas(natural gas,producer/water/coke-oven gas).Classify by origin as primary/natural and secondary/manufactured;renewable/non-renewable is another independent basis. Consider calorific value,moisture/ash,sulfur,ignition,storage,flame control,availability and emissions.Gases give controllable mixing butneed leak prevention/appropriate burners.Solid fuels need ash handling;liquid fuels need suitable atomisation.Heating,power generation,metallurgy and chemical synthesis use different purity and combustion requirements.GCV includes recovered combustion-water condensation heat;NCV excludes that latent heat.
a.gu: Controlled reaction,સામાન્ય રીતે combustionથી useful energy આપતો પદાર્થ fuel છે. State મુજબ solid(coal,coke,biomass),liquid(petroleum fuels,biofuels) તથા gas(natural,producer/water/coke-oven gas). Origin મુજબ primary/natural તથા secondary/manufactured;renewable/non-renewable અલગ basis છે. Calorific value,moisture/ash,sulfur,ignition,storage,flame control,availability તથા emissions જુઓ. Gasમાં mixing control સારું,પણ leak prevention/યોગ્ય burners જોઈએ. Solid fuelsમાં ash handling તથા liquid fuelsમાં atomisation જોઈએ. Heating,power,metallurgy/synthesisની purity/combustion requirements જુદી છે. GCVમાં combustion-water condensation heat આવે છે;NCVમાં તે latent heat નથી.

q.en: Explain the principle of Important industrial gases—types,sources and uses.
q.gu: Industrial Gases—પ્રકારો,Sources તથા Usesનો સિદ્ધાંત સમજાવો.

a.en: Industrial gases include oxygen,nitrogen,hydrogen,carbon dioxide,argon,acetylene and synthesis/fuel gases.Classify by function:oxidising,inert/shielding,combustible,reducing or process feed.A gas can fit more than one function;nitrogen is not chemically inert in every reaction. O2/N2/argon:air separation or suitable adsorption/membrane routes;steel/medical oxygen,inerting and welding shielding according to purity.H2:reforming,electrolysis or by-product recovery;ammonia,hydrogenation/refining.CO2:fermentation/process streams or geological sources with purification;carbonation,refrigeration and process uses.Acetylene:approved carbide or hydrocarbon routes;welding/chemical feed.CO/H2syngas:gasification/reforming,followed by conditioning for synthesis.
a.gu: Oxygen,nitrogen,hydrogen,CO2,argon,acetylene તથા synthesis/fuel gases industrial gases છે. Function મુજબ oxidising,inert/shielding,combustible,reducing અથવા process feed. એક gas એકથી વધુ functionsમાં આવી શકે;nitrogen દરેક reactionમાં inert નથી. O2/N2/argon air separation અથવા suitable adsorption/membrane routesથી;purity મુજબ steel/medical oxygen,inerting તથા welding shieldingમાં. H2 reforming,electrolysis/by-product recoveryથી;ammonia,hydrogenation/refiningમાં. CO2 fermentation/process/geological sourcesમાંથી purification પછી;carbonation,refrigeration/process usesમાં. Acetylene approved carbide/hydrocarbon routesથી;welding/chemical feedમાં. CO/H2syngas gasification/reformingથી તથા conditioning પછી synthesisમાં.

q.en: Explain the principle of Producer gas.

a.en: Producer gas is a relatively low-calorific fuel gas made by partial oxidation of coal/coke with air,commonly with steam moderation;nitrogen strongly dilutes it. Coal/coke,air and controlled steam;feed and ash behaviour govern the generator arrangement.
a.gu: Airથી coal/cokeનું partial oxidation,ઘણી વાર steam moderation સાથે,કરી મળતું relatively low-calorific,N2-diluted fuel producer gas છે. Coal/coke,air તથા controlled steam;feed/ash behaviour મુજબ generator arrangement હોય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Water gas.

a.en: Water gas is CO/H2-rich gas formed mainly by passing steam over hot carbon;the supplied regenerative process alternates air-blow heating and steam-run production. Coke/hot carbon,air for the blow period and steam for the product-generating run.
a.gu: Hot carbon પર steamથી મુખ્યત્વે CO/H2-rich water gas બને છે;મૂળ regenerative processમાં air-blow heating તથા steam-run production alternate થાય છે. Coke/hot carbon,blow period માટે air તથા product run માટે steam લેવાય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Coke-oven gas recovery.

a.en: Coke-oven gas is the combustible volatile-gas fraction recovered during oxygen-excluded carbonisation of coking coal. Coking coal,external heating and grade-specific gas-recovery reagents/scrubbing oil.
a.gu: Coking coalના oxygen-excluded carbonisationમાં મળતો combustible volatile-gas fraction coke-oven gas છે. Coking coal,external heating તથા grade-specific recovery reagents/scrubbing oil લેવાય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Natural-gas production and processing.
q.gu: Natural Gas Production તથા Processingનો સિદ્ધાંત સમજાવો.

a.en: Natural gas is a naturally occurring methane-rich mixture produced from reservoirs and processed to meet sales-gas specifications. Raw reservoir gas containing variable water,condensate,CO2,H2S and heavier hydrocarbons.
a.gu: Reservoirમાંથી મળતું methane-rich mixture natural gas છે;processingથી sales-gas specification મળે છે. Raw reservoir gasમાં variable water,condensate,CO2,H2S તથા heavier hydrocarbons હોય છે.

q.en: Explain the principle of Proximate-analysis balance.

a.en: 1.Given:on one consistent basis,moisture=8%,VM=30%,ash=12%. 2.Find:fixed carbon by difference.
